browse.leadTitle: Requests with no offers yet — if you can help, say “I have it”
browse.leadBody: Organizations and individuals post what they need but cannot find on offer. Saying “I have it” opens a private conversation, and an accepted agreement turns the request into a normal exchange.

detail.howTitle: What happens when you say “I have it”?

howSteps.1: A private conversation opens between you and the organization.
howSteps.2: You agree on the details and write the agreement there.
howSteps.3: Once confirmed, the request becomes a normal exchange with the usual steps.

pricing.resourceHint: + {percent}% VAT on the exchange value — any cash deposit is set in the agreement.

guide.1: Human service = service hours × hourly rate (1 to 5 Shahamham).
guide.2: Organization-to-public services = provider hours × hourly rate ÷ seats.
guide.3: The provider sets the hourly rate from 1 to 5; these limits protect the network from extreme pricing.
guide.4: You can publish for free; it is recorded at zero and does not reduce your allowance.

after.title: After publishing
after.body: Anyone who can help says “I have it”, opening a private conversation. You can receive several replies and choose one; the request becomes a normal exchange after you confirm the agreement.
